purpose: Pre-reanalysis audit of the published evaluation procedure and public code. This does not reproduce performance and does not fit a model.

publishedEvaluationProcedure.crossValidation: stratified 10-fold cross-validation with 90% training and 10% testing in each fold
publishedEvaluationProcedure.participantGroupingInterpretation: The article describes stratification by injured-to-uninjured ratio but does not report participant-grouped folds. Because the 6181 rows are repeated weekly samples from 142 runners, row-level splitting would allow the same participant to contribute to both training and testing unless a separate grouping mechanism is present.
publishedEvaluationProcedure.featureSubsetSelection: successively larger top-ranked feature subsets were compared using average AUC from stratified 10-fold cross-validation and the best average-AUC subset was selected
publishedEvaluationProcedure.lassoSelection: multiple alpha values were used to rank/select features, followed by iterative feature-subset testing
publishedEvaluationProcedure.hyperparameterTuning: average AUC from stratified 10-fold cross-validation; grid search also tuned oversampling strategies and sampling rates
publishedEvaluationProcedure.decisionThreshold: models were retrained with selected hyperparameters and a threshold maximizing F1 was determined for threshold-dependent metrics

representativeNotebookObservations: uses cv.split(X, y) without a groups argument
uses a fixed list of Relief-selected feature indexes before the cross-validation loop
collects out-of-fold predictions across all folds to choose an F1-maximizing threshold
runs the same 10-fold splitter again and reports threshold-dependent metrics using that globally selected threshold
publicCodeSnapshot.scopeBoundary: These observations are from one representative public KNN evaluation notebook and should not be assumed to describe every notebook without separate inspection.

risksToAuditBeforeReanalysis: participant dependence across repeated weekly rows
feature-selection optimism from ranking/selecting with information outside an outer validation loop
hyperparameter-selection optimism when the same cross-validation structure is used for tuning and final reporting
threshold-selection optimism for F1/sensitivity/specificity if threshold choice is not isolated inside training data
temporal leakage if future weeks from the same participant inform prediction of earlier weeks
preprocessing leakage if imputation/scaling/statistics are calculated outside training folds
requiredReanalysisDesign: verify stable participant identifier in the processed supplements
verify a weekly time/index variable and exact future outcome definition
freeze outcome, prediction horizon, candidate features, transformations, and model families before inspecting reanalysis performance
use participant-grouped outer validation or another pre-specified dependency-aware split that prevents participant leakage
fit imputation, scaling, feature selection, oversampling, model selection, calibration, and threshold selection using training data only
use nested validation when model/feature/hyperparameter choices are data-driven
report discrimination, calibration, uncertainty, prevalence-sensitive metrics, and subgroup/transport results separately
do not map laboratory biomechanics to webcam features until measurement compatibility is validated
